newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening mixed to a bit higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening mixed to a bit higher.

text.p: Wall Street is expected to open mixed to slightly higher on Wednesday as stock markets stabilize from a recent downturn, analysts said.
They said markets would be keeping an eye on U.S. payroll figures due out on Friday for signs of higher inflation and a possible rise in interest rates by the Federal Reserve.

"We'll see a mixed to slightly stronger opening but I don't think there will be any conviction or follow-through to the little rally we had yesterday," said Thom Brown, managing director of Rutherford Brown and Catherwood.
